protocol.name: nested_kfold_rating_cv
protocol.outer_test_policy: Each outer test fold is used only after inner tuning and outer-train refit.
protocol.ranking_candidate_policy: catalogue items excluding items observed by the user in the outer training fold
protocol.cold_item_policy: item has <= 2 ratings in the outer training fold

hybrid_selected_vs_cf_only.interpretation: Negative differences favor model_a because lower RMSE is better.

hybrid_selected_vs_cb_only.interpretation: Negative differences favor model_a because lower RMSE is better.
